project.title: Microbial diversity of municipal wastewater and river water in central Poland (Pilica River basin) part 1
project.description: River water was sampled at eight points along the river continuum, between upper Pilica and the confluence where Pilica flows into the Vistula. Samples of treated and untreated wastewater were collected in 17 municipal WWTPs (Wastewater Treatment Plants) distributed throughout the catchment area. Samples were collected four times between 8 May 2023 and 30 January 2024, including in spring (8-9 May 2023), summer (10-11 July 2023).
